column2: Morning in a Yaroslavl residential courtyard after first snow, a woman about 30 in a warm coat walks to her clean white Haval Jolion parked by a nine-storey building, holding a phone; the car's parking lights blink as it unlocks. Soft pink dawn light, fresh snow, cozy and safe mood.

Early winter morning, minus 20, frosty blue light; through a kitchen window of an apartment we see a man in a sweater holding a mug of coffee and a car key fob, outside in the courtyard his dark grey Chery Tiggo 7 Pro is running with headlights on and light exhaust steam, snow on roofs of other cars. Warm interior light vs cold blue outside.

Close-up of a man's hand in a winter glove holding a modern car alarm key fob with a small display, in front of a snowy courtyard where a silver Hyundai Creta stands with headlights on in the blue evening. Shallow depth of field, the fob in focus, fob screen without readable text.

Evening parking lot near a Yaroslavl shopping center, light snow; a young man checks a car-control app on his smartphone, the screen shows a simple car icon (no readable text), behind him his white Geely Coolray with lights on. Warm shop lights, wet asphalt reflections.

View from a 7th floor window of a panel building at dawn: in the snowy courtyard below many cars, one black Haval F7 has its lights on and is warming up; in the foreground on the windowsill lies a smartphone and a car key fob. Natural winter morning colors, not gloomy.

Night courtyard in a Russian city, sodium street light, a modern dark blue Toyota RAV4 parked under a lamp, light snow; a hooded silhouette with a small electronic device walks near the car, face not visible. Tense but realistic, cinematic, not post-apocalyptic, clean car.

Night, 3 a.m., a man in a jacket over pajamas stands at a snowy courtyard next to his grey Kia Rio whose hazard lights flash, he presses a key fob with a puzzled face; a few lit windows in the building behind. Realistic, slightly humorous, not dark.

Frosty morning, a family SUV Haval Dargo in a snowy private-house yard near Yaroslavl, the windshield is already clear of frost while other surfaces are frosty, a mother and a child in winter clothes walk to the car smiling. Bright low winter sun, blue sky, warm mood.

Winter evening at a dacha-style garage near Yaroslavl, a modern Skoda Octavia sedan parked by the garage with an orange extension power cable plugged under its front bumper, snow, warm light from the garage door, a man closing the gate. Realistic, cozy.

Split composition feel without split: a snowy morning street, two modern crossovers side by side at a curb – a red Haval Jolion with clean defrosted windows and a white Chery Tiggo 7 Pro still covered with frost, a woman scraping its window. Bright morning, realistic, light humor.

A fisherman's modern Haval H3 SUV parked on a snowy riverbank of the Volga at dawn, warm light inside the cabin, a man in winter fishing gear sits inside with a thermos, fogless windows, ice and mist on the river. Calm beautiful winter scene.

Inside a modern car on the M8 highway in late autumn, view from the back seat: a couple in front talking calmly and smiling, a child sleeping in a child seat, gray wet road and yellow autumn forest outside. Quiet and peaceful mood, warm cabin light.

A new dark green Haval H3 SUV on a gravel country road near Yaroslavl in late November, light snow on fields, the driver visible through the side window relaxed. Realistic automotive photo, no logos readable, no plates.

Close-up of a person closing the front door of a modern silver Hyundai Solaris in a city parking lot, the door shuts with a solid feel, motion captured, autumn leaves and wet asphalt. Realistic, bright daylight.

Low angle close-up of a studded winter tire of a modern white crossover Chery Tiggo driving on a slushy Yaroslavl road, slush splashing into the wheel arch, motion blur, city lights. Dynamic, realistic.
A modern Kia K5 sedan on the M8 highway at dusk, rear three-quarter view, wet asphalt, long road ahead, warm taillights, autumn forest. Realistic automotive photo.
Open hood of a modern grey Geely Monjaro in a clean bright car workshop, a technician in a dark uniform inspects the underside of the hood; clean floor, soft light. Realistic, professional.

Night, young couple sitting in a modern car Haval F7 parked on the Volga embankment in Yaroslavl, city lights and the river behind, warm interior light, they listen to music with joy, the woman laughing. Lively, warm colors.

Close-up of a car door with the inner panel removed in a clean workshop, a new component speaker being installed by hands in gloves, warm workshop light, modern car interior visible. Realistic, detailed.
Interior of a new Haval H3 SUV, view from the back seat to the dashboard, driver's hand on the multimedia screen choosing music, winter road outside, warm light. No logos readable.
Open trunk of a modern hatchback Kia Rio X in a parking lot, inside a neat compact subwoofer box next to shopping bags, a young man loading groceries, autumn evening, warm light. Realistic.
A red Haval F7 parked on a quiet street in Yaroslavl in early winter, trunk open, an underfloor subwoofer neatly installed in the side niche visible, soft daylight. Realistic automotive photo.
A driver in a modern car Hyundai Solaris turns up the volume knob and winces, frosty window, morning traffic outside, close shot of hand and face. Realistic, light humor.

Driver's view in a modern Hyundai Solaris: a large 9-inch Android head unit with navigation map on screen (no readable text), the driver's hand taps the screen, traffic jam on a bridge in the background with the Volga river. Warm daylight.

Close-up of a sleek large vertical Android multimedia screen in a modern crossover dashboard (Chery Tiggo style), music and map split screen with abstract icons (no readable text), soft evening light, rain drops on the windshield.
A young woman in the driver's seat of a modern Kia Rio sets up an Android screen, holding her phone next to it, parked in a courtyard, cozy daylight, focused and calm expression.

Evening, a modern Haval Jolion reversing into a tight parking spot between snowdrifts in a courtyard, view from the driver's seat to the multimedia screen showing a rear camera image with parking guide lines. Realistic, warm.
A modern grey Haval Dargo SUV towing a small boat trailer on a country road near the Volga in late autumn, golden fields and first light snow, sunny. Realistic automotive photo.
A mother with shopping bags in both hands and a child next to her at a supermarket parking lot, the tailgate of a white Haval Jolion opens by itself, light snow, warm store lights. Lively, realistic.

A modern white Hyundai Solaris parked by a Yaroslavl panel building in early winter evening, through the open driver door we see a glowing large Android screen in the dashboard, a young man sitting sideways with one foot outside, smiling at the screen. Warm light.
